title: Understanding Cross-Entropy Loss
text: Cross-entropy loss is often preferred over squared loss in classification problems. Think about how each loss function penalizes errors.

title: Penalty for Wrong Predictions
text: Consider how cross-entropy loss penalizes predictions that are very confident but incorrect compared to squared loss.

title: Sensitivity to Probability Estimates
text: Cross-entropy loss is sensitive to the predicted probabilities, especially when they are close to $$0$$ or $$1$$. How does this affect the learning process?

hintAnswer: $$Cross-entropy$$ loss gives a higher penalty to very wrong probabilities, encouraging the model to be more accurate in its probability estimates.
